pr_title: fix initial state of checkboxes in display layer
pr_body:
When having multiple checkboxes with the same name, they behave like radiobuttons and the value "V" is equal to the export value of the checked checkbox.

Fixes #12716.

issue_context.title: Radio-Button group shows all buttons as checked while only one is
issue_context.body:
Attach (recommended) or Link to PDF file here: [form-cms1500.pdf](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/files/5670936/form-cms1500.pdf) (Original opened in Acrobat and checked one radio-button)
Original Source: https://www.cigna.com/static/www-cigna-com/docs/health-care-providers/form-cms1500.pdf

Configuration:
- Web browser and its version: FF 83.0
- Operating system and its version: Win 10 Pro
- PDF.js version: 2.7.355

Steps to reproduce the problem:
1. Open the PDF here: https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/web/viewer.html
2. See that all radio-buttons are checked, which is wrong.

What is the expected behavior? (add screenshot)
![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12390057/101734698-f72d3900-3ac0-11eb-817e-94ce276797e8.png)

What went wrong? (add screenshot)
![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12390057/101734712-fc8a8380-3ac0-11eb-833d-412243a7950c.png)

This radio-button field can be found in object `45 0 obj`.

review_comments: It should be enough to have `data.fieldValue === data.exportValue`.

I first thought too, but the data.exportValue is defined in [here](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/6249ef517d3aaacc9aa6c9e1f5377acfaa4bc2a7/src/core/annotation.js#L1923). So there might be cases where this can be undefined?!
Hi @calixteman . Do you think this should be enough because the pdf might be broken if the exportValue is not set? Should I change it according to your suggestion?
It's likely better to be defensive so +1.
